rationale: The previous iteration showed only marginal improvement with persistent line loss events and relatively high steering oscillation, especially on the s-bend track. Feedback recommended lowering kp to 0.9 to reduce aggressive steering corrections, increasing kd to 0.1 for stronger damping, and slightly increasing ki to 0.07 to balance integral action without causing oscillations. I implemented these changes while keeping the base_speed and sensor_weights unchanged from the last iteration, as they were balanced. The geometry remains unchanged as it was appropriate. I expect these adjustments to stabilize steering, reduce line loss events, and improve the likelihood of completing the tracks. The requested measurements will confirm improvements in completion, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation.
